title: Copilot agent workflow: publish Copilot draft PRs on open when they already have changes, else wait for Copilot's review request
answers: Why did a Copilot-created draft PR stay in draft and never get a review run?
Copilot opened an empty draft PR; when does the workflow mark it ready for review?
Where is the logic that decides which Copilot draft PRs get published automatically?
Does a human review request on a Copilot draft PR trigger the publish step?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml, job publish-draft, handles pull_request_target events (opened, review_requested) for draft PRs authored by the Copilot bot account, and decides whether to mark them ready for review.
Rule: Trigger on both opened and review_requested. Publish on opened only when github.event.pull_request.changed_files > 0 (includes pure renames). Publish on review_requested only when github.event.sender.login == 'Copilot'. Keep the user.login == 'Copilot' and user.type == 'Bot' identity checks and the linked-issue comment step unchanged.
Symptom: A Copilot draft PR that already contained file changes at open time stayed in draft, so the initial review run was skipped; the review only ran after a manual or later ready-for-review transition.
Constraints: Empty opened drafts (changed_files == 0) are intentionally left alone and wait for Copilot to request a review after finishing. Human-originated review requests must not publish a Copilot draft. Does not apply to non-Copilot PR authors.
applies: Changes to the Copilot Agent GitHub Actions workflow's draft-publishing conditions; not for other workflows.
says: Automated draft pull requests with changes remain stuck in draft without triggering reviews.
Automatically mark assistant pull requests ready for review when they open with changes.
Empty bot pull requests should wait for review requests before being published.
Human reviewers requesting reviews on bot draft pull requests should not publish them.
search: In .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml:publish-draft, handle pull_request_target opened and review_requested events to publish Copilot bot draft PRs. The job marks a draft ready for review on opened only if github.event.pull_request.changed_files > 0, and on review_requested only when github.event.sender.login == 'Copilot'. Empty opened drafts wait until Copilot finishes and requests review, while review requests from human senders must not publish drafts. This applies specifically to the Copilot Agent workflow's draft-publishing conditions.
